cross_check.method:
One direct HTTPS GET of the official portal HTML for this section (raw_html_sha256 and response_bytes pinned in source) and one GET of its print/PDF render (entityprint/pdf/node redirects to print/pdf/node). The verbatim excerpt was extracted PROGRAMMATICALLY from the raw HTML (the field--name-body container): defined terms (bold-italic ) written #term#; one block per paragraph/list item in page order; a heading line and its following text (a double
in the HTML) are separate blocks; runs of whitespace and non-breaking spaces collapsed to one space and each block trimmed; embedded figures omitted. The print/PDF was converted to text (pdftotext -layout) and its body was compared word-for-word with the extracted excerpt (whitespace and hyphenated line-wraps normalised on both sides). The list-item LABELS in the excerpt are the labels this print/PDF prints in front of each item (the HTML renders them as CSS ordered-list markers with no label glyph in the page text). The section's table is NOT inlined in the excerpt (a placeholder marks its place); it is carried cell-by-cell in the structured `table` field, read directly from the HTML cells (unambiguous source order). NOTE: pdftotext -layout renders the two-column district table so that the longest district cells wrap and interleave across the two columns (e.g. the R10 row prints 'C6- R10 7' where the HTML cell is 'C1-9 C2-8 C4-6 C4-7 C5 C6-4 C6-5 C6-6 C6-7 C6-8 C6-9'); the HTML cell order is authoritative and is what the structured `table` field records. The print/PDF confirms each row's district->residential-equivalent mapping and the token set; only the visual left-to-right order of tokens in the long cells is a -layout artifact.
cross_check.result: match (prose); table carried cell-by-cell in the structured `table` field
